description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____'s first ability triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Last Voyage of the _____ to it.
Abdel Adrian's first ability triggers, exiling Last Voyage of the _____ and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
All permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian return to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
